items.stem: Which action is a core element of standard (universal) precautions in the medical office?

options.text: Performing hand hygiene before and after patient contact
options.rationale: Correct: hand hygiene before and after contact is foundational to standard precautions.

options.text: Wearing gloves only for patients known to have an infection
options.rationale: Standard precautions apply to all patients, not only known infections.

options.text: Recapping used needles by hand to save sharps space
options.rationale: Recapping by hand is unsafe and contrary to sharps-safety practice.
Single-use items must not be reused between patients.

items.explanation: Correct: hand hygiene before and after contact is foundational to standard precautions.

items.stem: A patient asks the medical assistant to release their records to a relative. What is the appropriate first step?

options.text: Obtain the patient's written authorisation before releasing records
options.rationale: Correct: protected health information requires the patient's authorisation before release.

options.text: Release the records immediately to any family member
options.rationale: Records cannot be released to family without proper authorisation.
Records can be released with proper authorisation; blanket refusal is incorrect.

options.text: Post the records where the relative can see them

items.explanation: Correct: protected health information requires the patient's authorisation before release.
